understanding.goal_understanding: Complete each level by moving the selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked '+' in the semantic grid is simultaneously occupied by a selectable piece, progressing through all levels until the game reports WIN for the final run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: The currently selected piece (shown as 'P') moves in 3-pixel increments per grid cell using MOVE_* actions, with x increasing to the right and y increasing downward. Movement can be blocked by walls ('#') or other objects, and the movement.{direction}_blocked flag is only a hint (an adjacent object may or may not truly prevent motion). Pushable blocks ('B') can be displaced if they are directly adjacent in the move direction and there is space for them to shift along with the selected piece. If multiple selectables exist (others shown as 'S'), control can be switched via CLICK by providing the exact pixel coordinate of the target selectable as listed in the state.

understanding.goal_understanding: Complete each level by moving the selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked '+' in the semantic grid is simultaneously occupied by a selectable piece, progressing through all levels until the game reports WIN for the final run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: The currently selected piece (shown as 'P') moves in 3-pixel increments per grid cell using MOVE_* actions, with x increasing to the right and y increasing downward. Movement can be blocked by walls ('#') or other objects, and the movement.{direction}_blocked flag is only a hint (an adjacent object may or may not truly prevent motion). Pushable blocks ('B') can be displaced if they are directly adjacent in the move direction and there is space for them to shift along with the selected piece. If multiple selectables exist (others shown as 'S'), control can be switched via CLICK by providing the exact pixel coordinate of the target selectable as listed in the state.
